maintenance_led.reason: Sells freight transportation: intermodal, dedicated, truckload, LTL and last-mile delivery to shippers, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private shippers such as retailers, distributors and manufacturers who pay for freight moves.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through intermodal, dedicated contract and 360 platform growth, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Intermodal and truckload freight can be rebid to other carriers, though dedicated contract fleets are stickier.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call: dedicated contract fleets are stickier than the larger intermodal and truckload business.
